verdict.rationale: Permissions and roles are a fair question for a collaborative workspace like Notion, but the evidence pack never documents user-level roles or page and database view/edit permissions. The only access-related items cover integration scoping: internal connections scoped to one workspace, Custom Agents shared explicitly with a connection, and workspace owners managing MCP client access. Those are adjacent controls for connections, not the role-based permissions this story asks for.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
